T: Lowell's own. Pull up a stool.
D: A working-class boxer from Lowell, Massachusetts tries to escape the shadow of his troubled brother.
P: Serve the mains when Micky takes Charlene out after her shift at the bar.
S: the local bar where Charlene works
Salted peanuts roasted with a little butter and smoked paprika, and a bowl of pickled onions, served on the bar.
Beef topside roasted rare, sliced paper thin, piled into soft rolls with a tangy barbecue sauce, mayo and white American cheese.
Bacon rendered, onion, celery and potato softened, clam liquor and milk added, clams and cream at the end, served in small cups with oyster crackers.
M: the loud house full of sisters
Beef chuck pot roast seared, onion, carrot and celery, stock and thyme, braised at 160C for 3 hours, potatoes for the last hour.
Lowell, the whole family at the table
Ziti baked in tomato and sausage sauce with ricotta and a mozzarella crust. Brown 400g Italian sausage meat, add 700g passata and simmer 15 minutes.
W: Two vanilla sponges baked at 175C, sandwiched with chilled vanilla pastry cream, topped with dark chocolate ganache poured over and left to set.
K: Cold lager or a stout poured slowly and left to settle, in pint glasses at the bar.

s.note: the local bar where Charlene works
s.how: Toss 300g peanuts with 20g melted butter, 1 tsp smoked paprika and flaky salt. Roast at 170C for 12 minutes. Serve on the bar with a bowl of pickled onions.
Roast a 600g beef topside at 200C until 52C, rest and slice paper thin. Mix 3 tbsp barbecue sauce with 3 tbsp mayo. Pile the beef into 12 slider buns with the sauce and a slice of American cheese.

m.note: Lowell, the whole family at the table
m.how: Brown 400g Italian sausage meat, add 700g passata and simmer 15 minutes. Toss with 500g cooked ziti or penne and dollops of 250g ricotta, top with 200g mozzarella and parmesan and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.how: Whisk 4 eggs and 150g sugar until thick and fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 20 minutes. Cook 400ml milk, 3 yolks, 80g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour until thick and cool. Fill and pour over 150g chocolate melted with 100ml cream.

d.how: Chill four pint glasses. Pour 500ml lager or stout into each, slowly, and let the stout settle before topping up. Raise a glass to Lowell.
